BiblicalUsage: To press is to crowd and oppress, and Joel says the locust army will not press upon one another as they march. The LORD raises up judges because He is pressed by the groaning of His people under their oppressors. The word is pressure from without and pressure from within.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God hears the groaning of the pressed, and He raises up deliverance for them.
